mapper.select: SELECT a.VARIABLE, b.DESCRIPTION, a.NEWVAL FROM HDOC_ADCA_MODIFICATION a LEFT JOIN HDOC_VARIABLES b ON a.VARIABLE = b.VARIABLE WHERE a.SERIE = #{serie} AND a.CHNO = #{chnr}
mapper.update: UPDATE HDOC_ADCA_MODIFICATION SET NEWVAL = #{newval}, UPDATE_DATETIME = NOW(), UPDATE_USER = #{user}, UPDATE_PROCESS = 'UD05ModifyDocumentApi' WHERE SERIE = #{serie} AND CHNO = #{chno} AND VARIABLE = #{variable}
